BiblicalUsage: liphnay means before, in front — rare in the text, and exact where it appears. In 1 Kings 6:17, "the temple before it".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the temple before the temple — the house before it, forty cubits long — shows me that God's house had rooms for every part of His service.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
